original_ai_output.title_zh: 琼莱州Twic East与Duk两县任命看守专员，紧张局势持续
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹琼莱州新任看守州长Moses Majok Gatluak任命了Twic East和Duk两县的看守专员。这两个地区的青年自2023年以来间歇性发生暴力冲突，近几周局势升级，上周Twic East一武装青年团体袭击Duk县Apiir Palaidhiim村居民，造成十余人死亡。当地妇女协会欢迎任命，并呼吁州长成立和平委员会以对话解决暴力根源。

location.raw_text: Twic East and Duk counties, Jonglei State

key_facts.fact: 琼莱州看守州长任命Twic East和Duk两县看守专员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The newly appointed caretaker governor of Jonglei State, Moses Majok Gatluak, has appointed caretaker commissioners for Twic East and Duk counties

key_facts.fact: 两县青年自2023年以来间歇性发生暴力冲突
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: where youth from the two areas have been involved in intermittent violence since 2023

key_facts.fact: 上周Twic East武装青年团体袭击Duk县Apiir Palaidhiim村，造成十余人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: more than a dozen people killed last week when an armed youth group from Twic East attacked residents in Apiir Palaidhiim village in Duk County

key_facts.fact: 当地妇女协会呼吁州长成立和平委员会以对话解决暴力根源
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Our appeal is that the governor should establish a committee inclusive of affected communities, youth, women, faith-based groups and politicians.

uncertainties: 事件为单一来源报道（Radio Tamazuj），尚缺乏交叉验证
伤亡数字为报道所述，未获独立确认
